identity.title: Massive Quenched Galaxies at z ∼ 0.7 Retain Large Molecular Gas Reservoirs

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present ALMA CO(2-1) observations of two of these post-starburst galaxies at $z\sim0.7$ with $M_*\sim2\times10^{11}\,M_\odot$.

question.value: Do recently quenched massive post-starburst galaxies at z~0.7 still retain large molecular gas reservoirs, as tested with ALMA CO(2-1)?

evidence.quote: we investigate the role of gas supply in suppressing star formation by studying the molecular gas content of post-starburst galaxies.
The ALMA observations were carried out in program 2016.1.01126.S (PI: R. Bezanson)
using the ALMA Band 4 receivers
CO(2–1) is significantly detected in both target galaxies.
The observations reach a spatial resolution of 2.2$\times$3.0$''$(16$\times$22$\,$kpc) and 1.7$\times$2.4$''$(12$\times$17$\,$kpc)

time_on_source.value: ~100 min per target (two 80 min blocks each)

evidence.quote: The total on-source integration time for each target was $\sim$100 min.

findings_qualitative.value: Gas masses are an order of magnitude above comparable-mass local galaxies; quenching need not remove molecular gas.

evidence.quote: Our observations suggest that quenching does not require the total removal or depletion of molecular gas

claims.hypothesis: Quenching requires depletion/removal of molecular gas
claims.experiment: ALMA CO(2-1) of two z~0.7 post-starburst galaxies
claims.result: M_gas of 6.4e9 and 34e9 Msun, high for their SFR
claims.finding: Quenching can occur with large gas reservoirs

evidence.quote: Models that require the complete depletion or ejection of molecular gas to quench star formation are inconsistent with the large gas masses

claims.hypothesis: Obscured star formation explains the gas excess
claims.finding: Cannot rule out obscured SF for J0912+1523

evidence.quote: $\sim60~M_\odot$/yr of obscured star formation is required to account for the significant gas reservoir in SDSS J0912+1523.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Lower alpha_CO, bottom-heavy IMF, short-term SFR variations, or obscured SF could explain high gas masses

evidence.quote: there are several alternative explanations for the high gas masses in SDSS J0912+1523 and SDSS J2202-0033.

limitations_admitted.value: Factor of two systematic uncertainty from CO excitation and alpha_CO; very small sample

evidence.quote: there are also factor of two systematic uncertainties associated with the CO excitation and conversion factor.

reproducibility.score_reason: Simple analysis with public ALMA project, but imaging/fitting details are sparse.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple numeric results (line flux, M_gas), though details are thin.
